description: Capture the raw SAY/SPEAK character start while the verb's lexical entry is still intact, publish a one-byte speech marker only after the classic parser resets scratch state, and let the speech action read through the raw zero-terminated input rather than depend on dictionary tokenization.

replacements.old:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
replacements.new:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SET SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 7>>>
	       <SET SPTR <+ .SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 6>>>>
	       <SET EPTR <+ .SPTR 1>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
